title: How long will this queue take?
summary: A phone-first estimator for a real queue: set the people ahead, the counters open and a Fast, Typical or Slow pace (or minutes per person) for an estimate such as about 9 min, likely 6–12 min, from 400 seeded runs with varying service times, beside a people-to-counters diagram. Compare another queue with a plain statement of what changed, time your wait from timestamps, record when you are served to see estimated against actual and the pace that explains it, observe the pace by tapping as people finish, and switch between a shared line and a line per counter or mark quick and slow customers. Food order mode compares the time waited with the wait you expected, with what-ifs that are never treated as measurements and an estimate only from orders you watched finish. Save the estimate as a narrated beamdswitch deck. Works offline, from file:// and in an iframe.
